title: Lost ID Card
executive_summary: Speakers discuss the topic of lost ID cards and agree to find a solution.
key_points: Speakers agree to find a solution to the problem of lost ID cards.
Speakers mention that the shop is busy, but they are the most popular shop in the area.
Speakers mention that they will tell you what is available when you come to the shop.
